candidates.title: Daily sales by product (till system)
candidates.why_relevant: Catalog describes units_sold and revenue_eur per sale_date and product_code, daily grain, refreshed daily (last_refreshed 2026-10-14), temporal_coverage start 2022-01-01 with end open. Covers both windows on paper; no PII flagged.
suspected_issues: Till replaced 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10: no rows for those days (wiki till_migration_2024), must be treated as missing, not zero; count of missing days not yet profiled
Product codes changed from 2024-04-01; codes ending in 'L' replaced (wiki product_codes_2024, last edited 2024-04-02); same product appears under two codes
Wiki dates for the till replacement (Feb-Mar 2024) and the code change (Apr 2024) differ; sequence to be confirmed
Catalog does not say whether revenue_eur includes VAT; units vs revenue treatment of returns/voids/zero-sales days undocumented
Classification confidential; access via request to Retail Operations (steward Marco Bianchi)

candidates.title: Product list (current codes only)
candidates.why_relevant: Gives product names and categories for current codes; needed to label N1 rows. Does not hold pre-2024 codes, so it cannot serve as the N2 mapping on its own.
candidates.found_via: search_internal_catalog; get_catalog_entry internal.sales.products; wiki product_codes_2024 backlink
suspected_issues: Lists only current product codes (wiki product_codes_2024 and catalog description); retired codes absent
Last refreshed 2025-03-31 per catalog, refresh on change; may not reflect later changes

candidates.title: Shop calendar (opening days, closures, local events)
candidates.why_relevant: Catalog has calendar_date, is_open and event_name at daily grain, coverage from 2022-01-01, ~1500 rows, owned by Store Operations. Directly addresses opening/closed status and local events.
suspected_issues: No wiki backlinks; no wiki page documents the calendar, so reliability of closures and events is unverified
Event coverage for past years and end dates unknown

candidates.title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis)
candidates.why_relevant: Register lists daily reanalysis for the windows; approved for prototyping and production; no agreement needed. Requires daily temperature_2m_max with timezone Europe/Rome and an assumed northern-Italy coordinate recorded in decisions.md.
suspected_issues: Register default_query uses UTC, hourly variables and 2014 dates; must not be reused for analysis windows
Reanalysis grid cell, not the shop's microclimate; no station-level accuracy claim

candidates.title: Nager.Date public holidays API
candidates.why_relevant: Returns national public holidays by year and country code; register lists it for prototyping and production with no agreement needed. Covers 2023-2026 years needed by both windows.
suspected_issues: National holidays only; regional patron-saint holidays for the assumed city not covered and need a separate source
Country code must be IT (register param notes give examples of other countries)

rejected_without_profiling.reason: Policy document for analyst-supplied dataset links, not a data source for this use case.

No internal crosswalk candidate found. A product-master export with historical codes, or Retail Operations confirmation of the mapping, is needed from the client.

N5 local events: no register source for the shop's municipal events calendar. The internal store.calendar has event_name but no wiki documents its coverage. A municipal events dataset would have to be supplied as a link by the human.

N4 regional holidays for the assumed city: Nager.Date covers national holidays only. No register source for regional or local holidays; the client must confirm whether these are required and who supplies them.
Shop city: not named in any source. The coordinate choice must be recorded as an assumption in decisions.md by the owner or analyst.
Licence, consent and owner terms for the internal sales extract are not stated in the catalog beyond classification confidential and access by request; unknown until Retail Operations responds.
